notes.title: The future of Day of the Rising Dead
notes.notes:
[p]Survivors,[/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback and have some exciting updates in the works for [i]Day of the Rising Dead[/i]. A new patch is on the horizon, and it's bringing a mix of player-requested changes, quality-of-life improvements, and gameplay tweaks that we think you'll love. Here's what’s coming soon:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🔚 Alternate Ending Incoming[/h3][p]You've fought your way through the hordes and uncovered the horrors of the outbreak—but soon, your choices will lead to a [b]new alternate ending[/b]. This will uncover a deeper truth of the epidemic.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]📂 Chapter Selection Rework[/h3][p]We’re removing the current [b]chapter selection[/b] system and replacing it with a more intuitive [b]Load Game[/b] option. This will give you more freedom to jump back into your journey without breaking immersion or replaying large sections unnecessarily.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💥 Better Weapon Placement & More Loot[/h3][p]Scavenge smarter, not harder. We’re improving [b]weapon placements[/b] throughout the game to make your arsenal feel more rewarding and better suited to your situation. Plus, expect [b]increased loot availability[/b] to help you stay one step ahead of the undead.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🪓 Melee Weapon Rebalance[/h3][p]It should feel powerful and purposeful. We’re tuning melee weapons to be [b]easier to use[/b] and more satisfying in combat.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🐛 Bug & Map Fixes[/h3][p]As always, we’re squashing bugs and smoothing out rough edges across the map. Expect [b]general fixes and visual cleanups[/b] to enhance your immersion and gameplay stability.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks to everyone who’s supported [i]Day of the Rising Dead[/i]. Your feedback fuels these improvements, and we can’t wait for you to experience the next evolution of the game. [b]The dead don’t rest, and neither do we.[/b][/p][p]See you in the apocalypse,
[b]- Director[/b][/p]
